findings.finding: The only guidance item (FY2026 efficiency ratio about 20%) cites a non-issuer source: a Motley Fool page read as a model summary (kind transcript, retrieval search_excerpt, independent false). The Q2 2026 release (dc_rel_q2_2026, read in full) contains no efficiency-ratio outlook (grep: only the reported 19.5% / 17.6% / 21.3%). Guidance must cite issuer documents; this is an unverified paraphrase of a call remark.
findings.fix: Either cite a verbatim issuer transcript or the issuer's webcast/IR transcript for the remark, or move it to notes as a secondary-source management remark (hypothesis) and leave guidance empty; no driver, event or key risk may rest on it as issuer guidance.

findings.finding: Geographic 'revenue' facts have a narrower scope than total revenue: the 20-F/6-K geographic table (note 34b) covers only interest income on card/loan/other receivables plus card income, late fees and fee/commission income, and excludes gains on financial instruments (float/investment income). FY2025 regions sum to 12,083.7M vs IFRS total revenue 15,774.7M (77%); Q2 2026 regions sum to 4,380.9M vs 5,513.2M. Labelling them revenue_by_region / 'IFRS revenue by geography' invites using them as shares of total revenue (field.json also states Brazil is '84% of FY2025 revenue' and Mexico '6.8% of FY2025 revenue', neither matching: Brazil is 91.3% of the geographic basis or 70% of total; Mexico 6.7% or 5.1%).
findings.where: gather/macro.json facts mc_f_rev_br, mc_f_rev_mx, mc_f_rev_ot, mc_f_rev_br24, mc_f_rev_mx24, mc_f_rev_ot24; gather/documents.json segments dc_s_br_q226..dc_s_ot_q225; gather/field.json competitors ITUB.why and bottleneck fd_bn_mexico_credit
findings.fix: Relabel the metric as 'interest_and_fee_revenue_by_region' (scope: receivables interest + fees, excludes financial-instrument gains), and correct the field shares to 'Brazil 91.3% / Mexico 6.7% of interest-and-fee revenue (FY2025)'; any regional share applied to total revenue must say the basis.

findings.finding: The newest fiscal-year operating income available to the engine is pf_operating_income_fy2024 = 5,630,057k, a derived companyfacts value that matches no IFRS line of Nu (gross profit 5,252,909k, pretax 2,795,198k); the numbers lane says so in notes but it remains a fact with metric operating_income, and no FY2025 operating-income-equivalent exists (ticker-trace reports FY2024 as the latest operating income). A bank has no IFRS operating income; using this value implies a ~49% FY2024 operating margin.
findings.where: gather/_prefetch.json fact pf_operating_income_fy2024 (source pf_cf_20250416); gather/numbers.json notes 'RECONCILIATION DIFFERENCES'
findings.fix: Repair/analyst: do not use pf_operating_income_fy2024 in any margin or driver; base profitability on nm_pretax_income_fy2025 (3,868,419k) and nm_net_income_fy2025 (2,871,672k); if the engine needs an operating_income row, add an nm_ FY2025 fact defined as pretax income (basis derived, note the definition) so the 2024 derived value is superseded.

findings.finding: Reported 2026 earnings carry a large income-tax benefit: Q2 2026 effective rate 14.2% (175,224k on pretax 1,236,313k) and H1 2026 11.8% vs 25.8% in FY2025, with deferred income taxes of -991,046k in the H1 cash flow (verified in nufs2q26_6k). TTM diluted EPS 0.7343 and Q2 net income 1,061,089k are reported IFRS but not a normalized run rate; the trailing P/E of 15.9 rests on them. The managerial view shows income taxes of 569.2M for Q2. The source of the benefit is not read (note 30 gap).
findings.where: gather/numbers.json facts nm_eps_diluted_ttm_2026q2, nm_net_income_2026q2, nm_income_tax_2026q2, notes 'TAX' and 'OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY'
findings.fix: State next to the result that 2026 IFRS earnings include a low-tax effect (about 146M in Q2 at a 26% rate); the analyst normalizes the tax rate in drivers and the multiple history is labelled 'on reported, tax-benefited EPS'.

findings.finding: Consensus EPS rows (0.89 FY2026, 1.13 FY2027) are stated non-GAAP by the provider page but carry metric eps_diluted with no basis, next to IFRS diluted EPS facts; consensus revenue 22.8B is on an unconfirmed (probably managerial) basis. The raw payload is a hand-written WebFetch summary, not a verbatim page save.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json consensus nm_cons_eps_fy2026, nm_cons_eps_fy2027, nm_cons_revenue_fy2026, nm_cons_revenue_fy2027; companies/NU/raw/web__consensus-estimates__annual.json
findings.fix: Add basis 'non-GAAP (provider)' to the EPS rows and 'managerial (unconfirmed)' to revenue rows; compare engine values on a like basis or show the basis gap.

findings.finding: Price 11.65 is an after-hours IB print (is_close false, 2026-10-30 23:56 UTC); the official 2026-10-30 close is 11.61 (IB October bar, also StockAnalysis). Difference 0.3%. The IB monthly history was retyped by hand into the raw file (high/low/volume omitted), against the save-verbatim rule.
findings.where: gather/numbers.json source nm_ib_price, notes 'PRICE' and 'IB PRICE CAUTION'; companies/NU/raw/ib__corporate-actions-NU__current.json
findings.fix: State the quote as the 2026-10-30 after-hours print or use the 11.61 close consistently; re-save price history verbatim if the multiple history is relied on.

findings.finding: Syndicated copies do not name their original: fd_meli_2q26 (Yahoo Finance syndicating the MercadoLibre release) and fd_banorte_2q26 (MarketScreener syndicating Banorte's report) have syndicated_from null; MELI 2Q26 metrics and all Banorte/BBVA metrics therefore rest on a non-own source (search excerpts for Banorte and BBVA). MELI FY2025 revenue 28.893B does match MELI's own companyfacts (Revenues FY2025 10-K).
findings.where: gather/field.json sources fd_meli_2q26, fd_banorte_2q26, fd_bbva_2q26; competitors MELI, GFNORTE, BBVA
findings.fix: Set syndicated_from to the issuer release (or register the issuer's own release/6-K) and keep these competitor numbers as context only, not as drivers.

findings.finding: Unverified market-move claims: field hypothesis of a '20% one-day NU share fall' after the 25 Oct election and macro's 'iShares MSCI Brazil ETF down ~25% premarket' are search excerpts; IB data show prior close 12.05 (2026-10-29), September close 12.66, October close 11.61 and 13-week low 11.48, which do not show a 20% one-day NU fall in late October.
findings.where: gather/field.json bottleneck fd_bn_policy_hyp; gather/macro.json notes 'EXPOSURE Brazil politics' (mc_cnbc_election)
findings.fix: Keep both as unverified hypotheses; no event or scenario may cite a NU price move except from nm_ib_price / nm_ib_hist.
